summary: postinstall fetches and executes opaque binary from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a.tgz archive from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/) with certificate validation disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false) and no hash or signature verification. The archive is extracted, the contained binary is chmod'd to 0755, hardlinked into bin/.onecode, and executed by the package's launcher. The destination is not the npm registry and is not a publisher domain; the fetched bytes are opaque and unverifiable. Any operator of that IP (or any on-path attacker, given TLS verification is disabled) can deliver arbitrary executable content that runs on the installer's machine as part of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
